sealed_statement.normal_form: Every final residual Y0 component is compiled into at most six stable selector vertices h_{C,M} with list M=MIN_BAD mask and neighborhood D_C; the original dynamic graph G[U] is preserved exactly.
sealed_statement.exact_outside_lists: Dynamic vertices use A(u)=[4]\f(N(u)∩(S∪X0)), not merely source L_P(u).
sealed_statement.equivalence: The original final seeded-precoloring has an extension iff the selector list instance (H*,L*) has a list-coloring.
sealed_statement.reconstruction: From any H* coloring, compute each actual nonempty F_C and replay the stored C0 witness coloring of C in polynomial time.
sealed_statement.size: At most six selectors per residual component, so H* has O(n) vertices.
sealed_statement.p7: H* is P7-free because it is obtained from P7-free Q_ALL by deletions and independent false-twin blowups.
sealed_statement.four_list_selector: If a selector has list [4], it is the only selector for its component and expresses exactly NO_ALL_FOUR_COLORS on D_C.

source_context_candidate.observation: CSZ axiom (vi) restricts Y∩N(Y0) to one common source 3-list L=[4]\{c}; axioms (vii)-(viii) then control X interaction with the relevant components. This resembles a semantic architecture in which Y cannot alone realize all four colors and X supplies/controls the remaining component interaction.
source_context_candidate.warning: No replacement of literal (vi)-(viii) by selector semantics is claimed.

method_donor.Camby_Schaudt: P7-free graphs admit strong connected-dominating-set structure, and Hypergraph 2-Colorability is polynomial for hypergraphs with P7-free incidence graphs. This is a structural-method donor only; H* is not asserted to be their hypergraph-incidence instance.

firewalls: This is not a polynomial solver for H*.
Different 3-list selectors can use different 3-subsets of [4], so ordinary P7-free List-3 does not directly apply.
List 4-Coloring is NP-complete already on P6-free graphs; P7-freeness of H* alone is insufficient.
No full L2 repair or Lemma11 P7 lift follows.
